title: Quick Start
description: The fastest path to a running API.

sections.title: Your First API
sections.content: The `init` command bootstraps your entire environment. It doesn't just create folders; it handles the configuration, environment setup, and dependency installation in one shot.

examples.explanation: Initializes the project using the global alias
Initializes the project via the direct entry point

sections.title: The Process
sections.content: The initialization follows a four-step flow: 1. Launch `nb init`. 2. Configure prompts (Port, DB Name, Customizations). 3. Automated setup (Templates copied, .env created, `npm install` executed). 4. Launch server via `npm start`.
